style_reference: Existing original isometric overworld object sprites were used only for camera angle, painterly density, scale, and transparent-cutout presentation.
prompt_set_summary: Eight separate original high-three-quarter isometric fantasy strategy objects: a spiral waystone reward cache with satchel and scroll tubes; a rope-bound timber wagon; moss-roofed antler-post fenhound kennels; an open brightwood mill with saw wheel and pale plank stacks; a stepped ridge quarry with lifting tripod and ore rail; a narrow stair-wrapped watchtower with forked signal shutters and brazier; a canvas-awning roadside infirmary with herbs, basin, blankets, and four-leaf lantern; and reinforced ore crates with assay sack and pick. Every prompt required a single readable silhouette, transparent isolation, bottom-center contact, no text or protected Heroes design. A second identity-preserving background-extraction prompt removed only the generator-rendered checker field and retained the object, lighting, props, proportions, and compact contact shadow.
runtime_derivation: Trim transparent source bounds, proportionally fit to the authored footprint-specific maximum box, center on a 512x512 transparent canvas, strip metadata, and copy the normalized result to both trimmed-source and runtime paths.

items.prompt_subject: Low spiral-engraved waystone with leather satchel, two sealed scroll tubes, moss, and restrained amber reward pebbles.
items.accessible_description: A low split waystone carries a deep spiral route mark above a leather satchel, two scroll tubes, moss, and three amber pebbles.

items.prompt_subject: Low two-wheel timber cart loaded with rope-bound split logs, a wedged hatchet, and a rolled green-grey tarp.
items.accessible_description: A low two-wheel timber wagon carries rope-bound split logs, a side-wedged hatchet, and a rolled green-grey tarp.

items.prompt_subject: Compact two-bay timber-and-wattle kennel lodge with moss roof, antler-like posts, hanging leads, trough, and empty dark arches.
items.accessible_description: A moss-roofed two-bay kennel has two dark arched pens, curved antler-like posts, hanging leather leads, and a shallow trough.

items.prompt_subject: Broad open-sided brightwood mill with shingled roof, brass-rimmed saw wheel, log carriage, pale plank stacks, boom, and rear waterwheel.
items.accessible_description: A broad open timber mill frames a large brass-rimmed saw wheel, log carriage, pale plank stacks, lifting boom, and rear waterwheel.

items.prompt_subject: Stepped ridge quarry with lifting tripod and pulley, short ore rail and cart, squared blocks, ladders, wedges, and exposed blue-grey seam.
items.accessible_description: A stepped stone cut rises around squared blocks, a lifting tripod, ladders, a short ore rail, and an exposed blue-grey mineral seam.

items.prompt_subject: Tall narrow stone watch post with external zig-zag stairs, roofed lookout, summit brazier, and two forked signal shutters.
items.accessible_description: A narrow stone watch post climbs through external zig-zag stairs to a roofed lookout and glowing brazier between forked signal shutters.

items.prompt_subject: Roadside timber-and-stone infirmary with canvas awning, herb racks, four-leaf lantern, basin, blankets, and covered treatment porch.
items.accessible_description: A warm roadside lodge shelters a canvas treatment porch, herb racks, water basin, folded blankets, and a round four-leaf lantern.

items.prompt_subject: Two squat reinforced timber crates, one open with blue-grey ore, an assay sack, short mining pick, and loose stones.
items.accessible_description: Two squat iron-bound timber crates sit beside an assay sack and short pick; one crate is open and filled with rough blue-grey ore.
